trial_title: Tolerability, Safety and Activity of a Muscle Relaxant Molecule IDN5243 in Patients With Low Back Pain
brief_summary: This is a prospective cohort study, open-label, uncontrolled proof of concept trial. The trial objective is to evaluate the analgesic tolerability, safety and activity of IDN 5243 (3-glycosyl-3-O-demethylthiocolchicine derivative)administered intramuscularly at 4 mg b.i.d. for 5 days in the morning (8.00-10.00 AM) and in the evening (6.00-8.00 PM) in subjects with Low Back Pain (LBP).

eligibility_table.criterion: Male or female patients
eligibility_table.justification: criterion targets female; patient is male

eligibility_table.criterion: 18-70 years old inclusive
Signed Informed consent obtained prior the inclusion in the trial
eligibility_table.justification: The patient profile does not provide information on whether informed consent has been signed.
eligibility_table.clinical_question: Has the patient signed the informed consent form prior to inclusion in the trial?

eligibility_table.criterion: A diagnosis of LBP equal to or greater than 50 mm on VAS with severe or moderate lumbar muscle spasm naïve or in relapsing condition
eligibility_table.justification: The patient does not have a diagnosis of LBP (lower back pain) as per the criteria.

eligibility_table.criterion: Patients must have a medical history, physical and neurological examinations that support a clinical diagnosis of acute LBP that is felt down to the lower leg below the knee with the onset no longer than 30 days before Visit 1
eligibility_table.justification: The patient does not have a clinical diagnosis of acute LBP, as they have conditions unrelated to LBP.

eligibility_table.criterion: Patients must be appropriate candidates for treatment with study medication in the Investigator's clinical judgment
eligibility_table.justification: It is unclear if the investigator would consider the patient an appropriate candidate for the study medication.
eligibility_table.clinical_question: Does the patient have a history of cardiovascular events or conditions that would contraindicate the use of muscle relaxants?

eligibility_table.criterion: Patients must be able to appropriately verbalize pain characteristics and to complete all protocol required measurements/assessments without assistance
eligibility_table.justification: The ability to verbalize pain characteristics is not assessed in the profile.
eligibility_table.clinical_question: Can the patient accurately describe their pain characteristics using a standardized pain scale of 0 to 10 without assistance?

eligibility_table.criterion: Patients must be medically stable on the basis of physical examination, medical history, vital signs, and clinical laboratory tests performed at screening
eligibility_table.justification: The medical stability of the patient cannot be determined without physical examination and lab tests.
eligibility_table.clinical_question: Is the patient's blood pressure within the normal range of 90/60 mmHg to 120/80 mmHg during the screening examination?

eligibility_table.criterion: LPB of non-mechanical origin such as neoplasm, infection or inflammatory chronic disorder
eligibility_table.justification: The profile does not indicate the presence of LPB of non-mechanical origin, but it is not explicitly stated.
eligibility_table.clinical_question: Does the patient have any evidence of neoplasm, infection, or inflammatory chronic disorder as determined by imaging studies or laboratory tests?

eligibility_table.criterion: Serum creatinine level > 1.7 mg/dL or Urea > 17 mmol/l
eligibility_table.justification: No serum creatinine or urea levels are provided to assess this criterion.
eligibility_table.clinical_question: Is the patient's serum creatinine level greater than 1.7 mg/dL or urea level greater than 17 mmol/L?

eligibility_table.criterion: Severe to mild hepatic dysfunction
eligibility_table.justification: The profile does not provide information on hepatic function.

eligibility_table.justification: There is no information on the patient's blood count to determine if it is abnormal.

eligibility_table.justification: The patient has not used myorelaxant drugs within the specified timeframe.

eligibility_table.justification: The patient is male and does not fall under the exclusion criteria related to pregnancy or lactation.

eligibility_table.justification: The patient is male and there is no indication that he is not willing to use contraception if sexually active.

eligibility_table.criterion: History of back (cervical, thoracic or lumbosacral) pain as 50% of the time in the 1 year prior to the first visit

eligibility_table.justification: The patient does not have a history of any LBP episode within the specified timeframe.

eligibility_table.criterion: Medical history or physical examination results that suggest the acute LBP or any of the neurological symptoms or signs are caused by a serious medical condition (e.g., fever, chills, unexplained weight loss, bowel or urinary bladder dysfunction or incontinence, bilateral leg weakness, progressive weakness, paralysis)
eligibility_table.justification: There are no medical history or examination results suggesting serious medical conditions related to acute LBP.

eligibility_table.criterion: There is a high probability for surgical intervention for the back pain during the projected time on the study or that there will be an increase in the severity of the leg pain or deficits
eligibility_table.justification: There is no indication of a high probability for surgical intervention for back pain.

eligibility_table.criterion: Had either a surgical procedure involving the spine or intervertebral discs in the lower back region within 1 year prior to Visit 1 or had >1 surgical procedure(s) involving the spine or intervertebral discs in the lower back region
eligibility_table.justification: The patient has not had any surgical procedures involving the spine or intervertebral discs in the specified timeframe.

eligibility_table.justification: The patient does not have any painful conditions that could interfere with study assessments.

eligibility_table.criterion: History of epilepsy or recurrent seizures
eligibility_table.justification: The patient has no history of epilepsy or recurrent seizures.

eligibility_table.criterion: Unable or unwilling to discontinue all prohibited medications at the time of randomization and during the time of their participation in the study
eligibility_table.justification: The patient is not on any medications, so there are no prohibited medications to discontinue.

eligibility_table.criterion: Known or suspected history of alcohol or drug abuse based on medical history, physical examination, urine drug screening, or the Investigator's clinical judgment
eligibility_table.justification: The patient has no history of alcohol or drug abuse.

eligibility_table.criterion: Have filed or plan to file a worker's compensation claim for any issue related to the current acute LBP episode
eligibility_table.justification: There is no indication that the patient has filed or plans to file a worker's compensation claim.

eligibility_table.criterion: Currently involved in litigation or plan to seek legal recourse for any issue related to their acute LBP
eligibility_table.justification: The patient is not currently involved in litigation or planning to seek legal recourse.

eligibility_table.criterion: Known allergies, hypersensitivity, or intolerance to the study drug or any excipients used in their manufacture
eligibility_table.justification: There is no mention of known allergies, hypersensitivity, or intolerance to the study drug.

eligibility_table.criterion: Had previously been enrolled in a muscle relaxant clinical study within 30 days before the inclusion.
eligibility_table.justification: The patient has not been enrolled in a muscle relaxant clinical study within the last 30 days.
